privacy: Files stay on your device. No uploads, code execution, or remote resources.
formats: Read explanations, code, and saved results from an .ipynb file.
invalid: This file is damaged or does not have a readable notebook structure. Save a new copy from the original notebook application.
emptyFile: This file is empty. Choose a notebook with content.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this document. Close other tabs and try again.
encoding: This notebook is not valid UTF-8 text. Save a UTF-8 .ipynb copy from the original application.
localResources: Some attachments or local images are unavailable. Only resources included in this notebook can be displayed.
remoteResources: Remote images, styles, and fonts were blocked.
safePreview: Saved results may be out of date. Code is never executed. External links open only when selected.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the document.
version: This notebook format version is not supported. Save it as notebook format 4 in the original application.
emptyCell: This cell has no source text.
noOutput: No output was saved for this cell. Nothing runs in this viewer.
unsupportedCell: This cell type is not supported. Its saved source is shown as text.
unsupportedOutput: This saved output has no supported static representation.
interactive: Interactive widgets and JavaScript outputs are not run. An available static representation is shown instead.
renderingNotes: Notebook styles may differ. LaTeX equations remain as source text; audio and video are not played.
missingAttachment: This cell attachment is missing or cannot be displayed.
